handoff: Rule fold faithful, tests/typecheck/docs:emit green. Blocking: G1–G4 cite R1–R4 now meaning recovery rules; §19/§21 citations not rewritten (D1); Limitations cites deleted audit ids; garbled AGENTS.md:53; README lacks config link to Reference (B4). Minor lint gaps listed.

findings.title: G1–G4 cite R1–R4, which now resolve to the recovery rules
findings.detail:
G1–G4 end in '(R1)'…'(R4)'. These pointed at the problem rows of the PRD §2 table (git show origin/main:.agents/PRD.md line 17), which this change dropped. In RULES.md, R1–R4 are now the claim-loss rules in §13.1, so G1 reads as citing 'R1 Claim renewal is not a unit action'. B24 says citations must 'still resolve' to the right rule. Check H7's '(R1)' at RULES.md:186 too: it may have meant the recovery R1, but confirm it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Drop the (R1)–(R4) parentheses from G1–G4, or restate the problem inline.

findings.title: Citations to dropped PRD sections not rewritten
findings.detail:
D1: 'The handful of citations to a dropped section (§17, §19, §20, §21…) are rewritten to cite the rule or the doc that now holds the point.' These remain: test/e2e/team.test.ts:2 and :141 (§19.3), packages/core/test/unit/replay.test.ts:2 (§19 criterion 2), packages/adapters/src/herdr/index.ts:32 (§21). §19 and §21 no longer exist in RULES.md.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Cite the rule ids only (M3, T5, T6, X4, C2) or the doc that holds the point. grep -rn '§1[89]\|§2[0-2]' over packages/ and test/ should come back empty.

findings.title: Limitations cites ids from the deleted audit folders
findings.detail:
The audits this change removes cannot be resolved, so these refs are dead for a reader: (B8), (B7), (B10), 'rerun D2', (B9, F1), (F2), (D2), (F3), (C4), 'in run-3', (F10), (F14), and 'Unchanged from v1' (docs/limitations.md:28-41). B8/B7/B10 also collide with the spec's own Behaviour numbering. B16 asks that 'what I read is true today' for a newcomer. Rule ids such as HC1–HC3, P8 and S2 are fine.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Remove the audit refs and the 'Unchanged from v1' heading, and keep the gap text itself.

findings.title: Garbled sentence in the auto-mode Decision
findings.detail:
'Permission profiles per step are not built (`docs/limitations.md`), and every permission prompt surfaces every permission prompt as an implicit ask.' The repeated phrase makes the sentence ungrammatical.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: '…are not built (docs/limitations.md), and every permission prompt surfaces as an implicit ask.'

findings.title: README has no config pointer to Reference's config section
findings.detail:
B4 example: 'the README's "make it yours" says one sentence and links to the Reference section instead of repeating the layer order.' The README never mentions the config layers or links to Reference's config section; it names only remote.provider. Separately, AGENTS.md Process 'Workflows' retells the round chains that CONTRIBUTING's loop tells (B4 and B22: tell it once and link it).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add one sentence plus an anchor link to Reference's config section (the B36 lint will check the anchor). Trim AGENTS.md's chain retelling to a link to CONTRIBUTING, keeping only what an agent must follow.

findings.title: R rules grouped in §13.1 instead of spread per D2
findings.detail:
This is a declared deviation. The claims half of B25 is met, but R5 (heartbeat) and R6 (prompts and hooks) do not sit next to §8 and §9.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Accept it, or add a one-line cross-reference from §8 and §9 to §13.1's R5 and R6.

findings.title: Unknown verb of a real noun passes the command lint
findings.detail:
'norn story bogus' falls back to the longest known prefix 'story' and reports nothing, so B35 is enforced only for the first word.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: When the first word is a noun with verbs, require the second word to be a verb.

findings.title: Sweeps do not assert they scanned anything
findings.detail:
The command sweep and the link sweep pass vacuously if the extraction regresses and finds zero mentions or links.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Assert that the mention and link counts are above zero.

findings.title: textFiles walks untracked and ignored files and follows symlinks
findings.detail:
The PRD-name and stray-handoff sweeps can fail on a local dist/, coverage/ or .claude/worktrees/. .claude/skills symlinks are scanned twice, and a symlink loop would recurse forever.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Skip the known build and worktree dirs and do not follow symlinked directories.

findings.title: GitHub slug edge cases
findings.detail:
Link text in headings, a trailing '#' and setext headings are slugged differently from GitHub. None occur today.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add matcher cases when the first such heading appears.

findings.title: Leftovers
findings.detail:
Double blank lines where helpers moved out; the rules text is still named `prd` in repo.test.ts; docs.test.ts exports matchers nobody imports; the GEN marker strings are duplicated from reference.ts; reference.test.ts:48-49 has a redundant throw before expect.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Tidy these while in the file.
